command: smol-image sunburst (edit mode: each job sent the original Neconyan asset as the reference image)
style: Windows 98 era 256-colour dithered pixel art on a flat magenta key background
processing: Magenta chroma-keyed to transparency with fringe despill, trimmed, then fitted into the original asset's visible area on a canvas with the original aspect ratio (2x size for small art, 1x for illustrations, paws and portraits), because CSS content: url() keeps the replaced image box. Lossy WebP q88 with lossless alpha. The wallpaper has no key and is resized to 1536x1024.
